rows.ja: 配信プラットフォーム
競合(相手の資料に記載)

relations.text: 2025年12月期の収益の62%、総予約額の61%がApple App Store経由である
relations.text_en: Duolingo derived 62% of its revenue and 61% of its total bookings from the Apple App Store in 2025

source.label: Duolingo 10-K
source.quote: In the twelve months ended December 31, 2025, we derived 62% of our revenue and 61% of our total bookings from the Apple App Store, and 20% of our revenue and 21% of our total bookings from the Google Play Store.

relations.text: Appleとの配信契約は、Appleが30日前の書面通知で解約できる
relations.text_en: The distribution agreement with Apple is generally terminable by Apple with 30 days prior written notice

source.label: Duolingo 10-K
source.quote: In addition, our distribution agreements with Apple and Google are generally terminable by Apple or Google without cause with 30 days prior written notice (to the extent allowed by applicable local law).

relations.text: 2025年12月期の収益の20%、総予約額の21%がGoogle Play経由である
relations.text_en: Duolingo derived 20% of its revenue and 21% of its total bookings from the Google Play Store in 2025

source.label: Duolingo 10-K
source.quote: In the twelve months ended December 31, 2025, we derived 62% of our revenue and 61% of our total bookings from the Apple App Store, and 20% of our revenue and 21% of our total bookings from the Google Play Store.

relations.text: Googleとの配信契約は、Googleが30日前の書面通知で解約できる
relations.text_en: The distribution agreement with Google is generally terminable by Google with 30 days prior written notice

source.label: Duolingo 10-K
source.quote: In addition, our distribution agreements with Apple and Google are generally terminable by Apple or Google without cause with 30 days prior written notice (to the extent allowed by applicable local law).

relations.text: Duolingoは、Google Cloudから計算・保管の容量の提供を受けており、契約はいずれかの当事者が解約するまで継続する
relations.text_en: Google Cloud provides Duolingo with computing and storage capacity under an agreement that continues until terminated by either party

source.label: Duolingo annual report
source.quote: AWS and Google Cloud provide us with computing and storage capacity pursuant to agreements that continue until terminated by either party.

relations.text: Duolingoは、AWSなどから計算・保管の容量の提供を受けており、契約はいずれかの当事者が解約するまで継続する
relations.text_en: AWS provides Duolingo with computing and storage capacity under an agreement that continues until terminated by either party

source.label: Duolingo annual report
source.quote: AWS and Google Cloud provide us with computing and storage capacity pursuant to agreements that continue until terminated by either party.

relations.text: 語学学習の競合に挙げる
relations.text_en: Names Duolingo as a language-learning competitor

source.label: Chegg 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: The competitors for our language learning platform primarily include similar language learning platforms such as GoFluent, Speexx, and Duolingo.

source.quote: such as our partnerships with DC Comics, Duolingo and HYBE Entertainment

relations.text: デジタル教材の競合に挙げる

source.label: Stride 10-K(2026年6月期)
source.quote: Other competing digital curriculum providers, including Khan Academy, Duolingo, IXL
